dataset_source: Merged from Kaggle Crop Recommendation (18 Karnataka-relevant crops) + Karnataka Crop Dataset V2 (39 crops with district/soil/season data)
dataset_provenance: Combined dataset: 1,800 rows from Kaggle (non-Karnataka crops dropped: apple, jute, lentil, orange) + 21,960 rows from Karnataka V2. Karnataka V2 rainfall was normalized from annual to monthly (divided by 12). See data/analysis/merge_log.json for full provenance.
known_limitations: Karnataka V2 dataset is synthetically generated with Karnataka-specific parameters; not from verified field samples.
Kaggle crop recommendation data geographic origin is unknown.
Rainfall units were normalized (Karnataka V2 annual / 12 -> monthly); this is an approximation.
N values in Karnataka V2 range up to 280 (vs 140 in Kaggle) — may reflect different measurement scales.
Class distribution is imbalanced (200 to 1,300 samples per crop).
Model has not been validated against verified Karnataka field data.
Model should be considered an improved demonstration, not a production agricultural advisory system.
